reviews.title: Great price for great fans
reviews.comment: Always buy more fans than you need, as you will need them soon enough. These three case fans worked great for me. I needed something that supported PWM for my case, and I also needed good airflow while being quiet enough so as to not give me constant headaches. These have fit the bill.  Three fans for $12 is pretty ridiculous actually. Just get these. They're wonderful.
reviews.author: BC

reviews.title: Basic PC fans
reviews.comment: The fans are nothing special, just basic 120mm fans with rubber mounting. I needed some basic non argb fans for an old PC that needed refreshing, these did the trick perfectly without adding much wire bulk to the system and without making it glow like some kids toy. Using as an intake for the front of my pc case, it pulls in air just fine at medium RPM settings and the noise level is good as long as it's not ran at full power.
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Awesome fans!
reviews.comment: I needed a few extra fans for the top of my desktop. These worked great! They feel well made and thick. The frames are strong and felt firm when tightened. They are really basic fans, without a bunch of flashy lights, perfect for my build. They would would best as case fans, I dont think they have enough force to be used for radiators. They as quiet as my corsair fans, but much more budget friendly.
reviews.author: heartoD

reviews.title: Enhances not only performance but also the aesthetics of your build!
reviews.comment: I recently received the FA120 120mm Case Fan 3 Pack for my gaming PC build, and I couldn't be happier with my decision. Right out of the box, these fans impressed me with their sleek design and daisy chain feature, which makes cable management a breeze. No more tangled wires cluttering up my case! The quiet operation is another standout aspect. Even under load, these fans maintain a serene environment, which is crucial for an immersive gaming experience. I’ve tried other fans that advertised low noise levels, but the FA120 truly delivers. The 4-Pin PWM smart speed control is a game changer, allowing the fans to adjust their speed based on the system temperature, which keeps the airflow efficient without blasting noise. In terms of performance, the airflow is excellent. My CPU temperatures have noticeably improved since I installed these fans, and they’ve helped optimize the cooling for my radiator as well. I’m running a heavy gaming session, and I can’t hear a peep from the fans—they do their job incredibly well. Installation was straightforward, and the quality feels solid. I also appreciate that they come in a pack of three, giving you great value for the price. Overall, if you’re looking for a reliable, quiet cooling solution for your computer case or gaming rig, I highly recommend the FA120 Case Fan 3 Pack. It’s an investment that enhances not only performance but also the aesthetics of your build.

reviews.title: Basic case fans
reviews.comment: This is for "GSCOLER FA120 120mm Case Fan 3 Pack" Price at review time: $12.99 before 10% off coupon Fans tested out within the manufacturer ranges.  The pads at the four corners of the fan barely extend past the fan surface and won't provide much resistance to vibrations.
